summary: Specifies how packet information is exported from a PSAMP exporting process to a collecting process. It reuses the IPFIX protocol for the transport, since the two architectures match well. This document also covers how selected packet reports are carried using IPFIX mechanisms.

eli5.summary: After picking some packets to study, you have to send your notes to someone. This note says how to package and send those notes, borrowing the way another reporting system already works.
